description_en: Creates an Elastic Accelerated Computing Instance and a client ECS instance, and then attaches the Elastic Accelerated Computing Instance to the ECS instance
description_zh: 创建一个弹性加速计算实例和一个客户端ECS实例，并将弹性加速计算实例绑定到ECS实例上
kebab_example: aliyun eais create-eai-ecs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --eais-type eais.ei-a6.2xlarge --vswitch-id vsw-uf6h3rbwbm90urjwa0000 --security-group-id sg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEaiEcs

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value for this parameter on your client. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数，保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the EAIS instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 弹性加速计算实例的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: eais_name

fields.help_en: The ID of the image used to create the ECS instance
fields.name: image_id

fields.help_en:
The maximum inbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

If the outbound public bandwidth is 10 Mbit/s or less: 1 to 10. Default value: 10.

If the outbound public bandwidth is greater than 10 Mbit/s: 1 to the value of `InternetMaxBandwidthOut`. Default value: the value of `InternetMaxBandwidthOut`
fields.help_zh:
ECS实例公网入带宽最大值，单位为Mbit/s。取值范围：

当所购公网出带宽小于等于10 Mbit/s时：1~10，默认为10。
当所购公网出带宽大于10 Mbit/s时：1~`InternetMaxBandwidthOut`的取值，默认为`InternetMaxBandwidthOut`的取值
fields.name: internet_max_bandwidth_in

fields.help_en: The maximum outbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh:
ECS实例公网出带宽最大值，单位为Mbit/s。取值范围：0~100。
默认值：0
fields.name: internet_max_bandwidth_out

fields.help_en: The name of the ECS instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
fields.help_zh: ECS实例名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The password of the ECS instance. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length. It must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The supported special characters are `()~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/`
fields.help_zh: ECS实例密码。长度为8~30个字符，必须同时包含大小写英文字母、数字和特殊符号中的三类字符。特殊符号可以是：`()~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/`
fields.name: password

fields.help_en:
The category of the system disk for the ECS instance. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.

cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

cloud_essd: ESSD.

cloud: basic disk.

cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL disk.

For retired instance types and non-I/O optimized instances, the default value is \`cloud\`. For other instance types, the default value is \`cloud\_efficiency\`
fields.help_zh:
ECS实例系统盘的云盘种类。取值范围：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘。
cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL云盘。

已停售的实例规格且非I/O优化实例默认值为cloud，否则默认值为cloud_efficiency
fields.name: system_disk_category
system_disk_size

The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance belongs.

The number of available IP addresses in the vSwitch determines the maximum number of EAIS instances that can be created in the vSwitch. Plan your CIDR block in advance

实例所属的虚拟交换机ID。

交换机网段内IP的个数决定了该交换机最大可支持创建的EAIS实例个数，请务必提前规划好网段设置

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag. Constraints:

The key cannot be an empty string.

The key can be up to 128 characters in length.

The key cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

The key cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。限制：

不能为空。
最多支持 128 个字符。
不能以aliyun或acs:开头。
不能包含http://和https://

fields.help_en:

The value cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

The value cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh:
标签值。限制：

最多支持 128 个字符。
不能以aliyun或acs:开头。
不能包含http://和https://
